inputs.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Photorealistic absurd comedy look, cyberpunk lower-city street at night. Neon signs, steam vents, wet reflective pavement, noodle shop with glowing sign across the street. Woman A — exactly the same face, hair and costume as Picture 1: the same features and hairstyle, wearing an ornate heavy deep-blue robe with silver thread patterns, standing collar and wide sleeves, jade belt, long hair half-tied — ancient-style dress in a cyberpunk street is the visual joke. A small cream-white and warm champagne-gold round-headed robot with a screen face and a head lamp, knee-height, is her companion. They are SQUATTING ON THE CURB EDGE, backs against the graffiti building wall on the near sidewalk — NOT in the middle of the road. The road and noodle shop are in front of them. Dead-serious realism: camera and physics stay straight-faced. No fighting, no flying, no magic glow.

0-6s Close shot of the small robot. Its screen face suddenly lights up bright, its head lamp flashes green rapidly. It freezes for half a beat, screen showing an exclamation mark. Then it looks up sharply toward the wall above them.

overall_soundscape:
Street ambience, one electronic ping from the robot.
The small robot, childlike electronic voice, sudden realization: "等一下。我看到最优解了。"
Natural speech.
